title: Testing
subtitle: Run and review multi-platform tests (web, Android, Windows).
desktopOnly: Multi-platform testing is only available in the desktop app.
unavailable: The testing service is not available yet.

form.title: New test session
form.describe: Describe the test in plain language
form.describePlaceholder: e.g. Open example.com and check the page shows "Example Domain"
form.generated: Steps generated. Review them, then run.
form.modelHint: Pick the model for AI features. Some routed models reject direct calls — if generate fails, choose another model.
form.noUrlHint: Tip: set the app URL below first, so the generated steps open YOUR app instead of example.com.
form.name: Name
form.namePlaceholder: e.g. Homepage loads and shows the title
form.sourceHint: Pick your project folder — it reads the README/package.json and works out the dev URL + how to start it. No typing needed.
form.manualReady: Folder selected. Fill in the URL and commands below — no AI needed.
form.showAdvanced: Advanced: edit URL / commands / services manually
form.appCommandPlaceholder: Start command, e.g. npm run dev (leave empty if already running)
form.appHint: If you give a start command + folder, the test starts your app, waits for the URL, runs, then stops it. Leave the command empty to test an app you already started.
form.detected: Detected how to run the project. Review the commands below.
form.detectFailed: Could not detect how to run the project.
form.servicesHint: Optional. Add backend/database/worker commands; they start in order before the app and stop after.
form.exePathHint: The desktop app launched and driven on an isolated display.
form.androidHint: Installs the APK on the emulator (if given) and launches this package. Leave the APK empty to test an app already installed.
form.stepsPlaceholder: Generated steps appear here. You can edit them, or write your own (one per line).
form.stepsHint: Tip: just describe the test above and click Generate. Advanced: goto, wait, assertText, assertTitle, click, type <selector> => <text>.
form.failed: Could not run the test session.

report.empty: Select a session to view its report.
report.setupError: Setup failed — the test could not start. Details below:
